 Follow Julia Fox & Paris Hilton’s New Christmas Comedy Movie Gets Hilarious Prime Video Trailer
 Anuraag Chatterjee Tue, November 10, 2026 at 4:37 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Prime Video Julia Fox and Paris Hilton are all set to star in Prime Video 's upcoming Christmas rom-com from director Carlson Young. The trailer for Clashing Through the Snow reveals a hilarious premise in which Michelle Randolph and Christopher Briney play heated rivals at a publishing firm.
 Set during the holidays, Randolph portrays Hannah, while Briney plays Ryan. Both are told that the publishing market is shrinking and that one of them will be let go after the holidays. Given one last chance to prove their worth to the company, they both travel to New York City. However, bad weather derails their plans and forces them on a long journey together, where their rivalry gives way to something warmer.
 Check out the trailer for the movie here ( watch more trailers ):
 What happens in the Clashing Through The Snow trailer?
 The trailer for Clashing Through the Snow opens with a narrator introducing Hannah and Ryan. Both characters are shown dressed as Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus at a mall. As the narrator invites viewers to ponder their predicament, the trailer cuts to explain the movie's premise.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A week before, Hannah and Ryan were two editors at a publishing company. Ryan's boss tells him that either he or Hannah is on the chopping block. The trailer shows them bickering about who is better at their job. Their boss then informs them that he needs a bestseller. Both receive tips that different authors have unpublished manuscripts that they could leverage. They then head to New York and end up on the same flight.
 The trailer then shows everything going wrong for the duo. The flight has to make an emergency landing due to bad weather. The car they rent crashes in the snow due to Hannah's driving. They then end up in a hotel that might be run by a serial killer. What follows is a montage of them surviving the trip and seeing each other as more than corporate rivals.
 In addition to Hilton , Fox, Randolph, and Briney, the movie also stars Lukas Gage, PJ Byrne, Andrew Schulz, Zarna Garg, and Tan France. Daniel Mackey and Rebecca Ewing wrote the movie. Industry Entertainment, Luber Roklin Entertainment, and Wonderland Sound and Vision serve as the production companies. Amazon MGM Studios will distribute it.
 The movie arrives on Prime Video on November 23, 2026.
